 Get ready to mark your calendars -- the Jazz Fest 2027 lineup is coming today!
It's an unusually early release, but Josh Danzig of Where Y'at magazine says the major music fests want to get everything nailed down now before Christmas.
"A lot of them are announcing before the holiday season so that people can spend some of their holiday dollars on buying tickets and gifts and VIP packages and the like."
And who might play at the fest in 2027?
"The real clues are who's touring in late April and early May," said Danzig. As such, he listed off a few possibilities.
"Noah Kahan is a very hot Americana folk-pop singer-songwriter. He's doing a stadium tour. Leon Bridges, who has appeared at Jazz Fest a number of times, very popular, he'll be in the Dallas area in late April. If you're a country music fan, Eric Church is going to be on tour with Kenny Chesney, and they're going to be in the southern part of the United States in late April."
Danzig said Bon Jovi is also preparing to start a summer tour, and could possibly be on the lineup.
The fest is scheduled to open April 22.
